sources.name: Common European Framework of Reference for Languages
sources.allowedUse: Use as a non-prescriptive proficiency framework; never describe it as an official vocabulary list.
sources.evidence: The Council of Europe describes the CEFR as a non-prescriptive framework that does not tell practitioners what or how to teach.

sources.name: Plan curricular del Instituto Cervantes — Niveles de referencia para el español
sources.allowedUse: Use inventory structure, communicative functions and notion domains as an editorial mapping reference. Do not bulk-copy inventory entries into the app.
sources.evidence: PCIC presents a starting point that requires adjustment and adaptation; the CVC footer states that all rights are reserved.

sources.name: Corpus del Español del Siglo XXI (CORPES XXI), version 1.5
sources.allowedUse: Use query results and published aggregate frequency information for manual validation. Do not commit or redistribute raw downloaded lists until reuse terms are confirmed.
sources.evidence: The current public page reports 455,524,404 forms and 419,955 documents and describes CORPES as a resource under construction.

sources.name: wordfreq Spanish frequency data
sources.allowedUse: Generate attributed candidate JSONL records. Keep the source id and this manifest with redistributed derivatives.
sources.evidence: wordfreq states that its data files are redistributable under CC BY-SA 4.0 and that the frequency snapshot is unlikely to be updated beyond approximately 2021.

sources.name: Kaikki Spanish machine-readable dictionary / English Wiktionary
sources.allowedUse: Verify spelling, accents, part of speech, lemma and inflection relationships with attribution.
sources.release: Spanish extraction dated 2026-08-16 from the 2026-08-05 English Wiktionary dump
sources.evidence: Kaikki exposes structured Spanish entries and identifies the extraction and upstream Wiktionary provenance.

sources.name: AESAN — Lee y respeta lo que dice la etiqueta
sources.publisher: Agencia Española de Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutrición
sources.allowedUse: Use public consumer guidance to verify real Spanish label, date and storage terminology. Do not turn food-safety guidance into product guarantees.
sources.evidence: The guide distinguishes fecha de caducidad from consumo preferente and uses supermarket refrigeration, freezing, packaging and storage terminology.

sources.name: AESAN — Programa 2.4 Control del etiquetado
sources.publisher: Agencia Española de Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutrición
sources.allowedUse: Use the current public control plan to verify shopper-visible label fields and terminology; do not redistribute the document or present the learning cards as regulatory advice.
sources.evidence: The plan lists denomination, ingredients, allergens, net quantity, nutrition information, storage, origin and use instructions across packaged and unpackaged foods.

sources.name: Alcampo — Pollo al estilo oriental
sources.allowedUse: Use the public retailer page to verify names under which selected ingredients are presented to shoppers; do not copy commercial descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: The retailer recipe lists jengibre, salsa de soja, vinagre de arroz, cilantro and sésamo using current shopper-facing Spanish names.

sources.name: DLE — tique
sources.allowedUse: Use the public dictionary entry to verify the Spanish lemma and concise meaning; do not copy the full entry.
sources.evidence: The DLE records tique from English ticket with the meanings vale, bono, cédula and recibo.

sources.name: DLE — datáfono
sources.allowedUse: Use the public dictionary entry to verify the Spanish lemma and retail-payment sense; do not copy the full entry.
sources.evidence: The DLE defines datáfono as a device used in shops and other establishments for card payments.

sources.name: Aena — Control de seguridad
sources.allowedUse: Use the public passenger guidance to verify current airport-control and hand-luggage terminology; do not copy the page or imply endorsement.
sources.evidence: The passenger guidance uses control de seguridad and equipaje de mano in the real airport departure flow.

sources.name: Aena — Zona de salidas de Barcelona-El Prat
sources.allowedUse: Use the public airport guide to validate check-in, boarding-card, boarding-zone and gate terminology; do not reproduce the guide.
sources.evidence: The departure guide uses facturación, tarjeta de embarque, zona de embarque and puerta de embarque in a current passenger journey.

sources.name: Renfe Viajeros — Condiciones generales
sources.allowedUse: Use the public conditions to validate rail passenger, delay, cancellation and ticket terminology; learning cards are not legal advice.
sources.evidence: The conditions use retraso, cancelación, horario, título de transporte, reintegro and destino in passenger-service contexts.

sources.name: DGT — Tipos de infracciones y sanciones
sources.allowedUse: Use the public road-safety page to verify current driving and infringement terms; do not present cards as driving or legal advice.
sources.evidence: The DGT page uses infracción, sanción, multa, permiso de conducir, circulación, velocidad, semáforo and sentido contrario.

sources.name: Ministerio de Transportes — Movilidad sostenible
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible
sources.allowedUse: Use the public policy page to validate sustainable-mobility terminology; do not reproduce policy text or imply official course status.
sources.evidence: The public transport pages use movilidad sostenible, pedestrian and cycling infrastructure, and accessibility terminology.

sources.name: BOE — Ley de Arrendamientos Urbanos, texto consolidado
sources.publisher: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado
sources.allowedUse: Use the consolidated public text to validate rental-contract terminology; cards are language instruction, not housing or legal advice.
sources.evidence: The consolidated law uses arrendamiento, arrendador, arrendatario, contrato, renta and fianza in current housing-rental contexts.

sources.name: Centro Europeo del Consumidor en España — Garantías
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Derechos Sociales, Consumo y Agenda 2030
sources.allowedUse: Use the public consumer guidance to validate guarantee, withdrawal, defect and remedy terminology; cards are not consumer-rights advice.
sources.evidence: The guidance uses garantía legal, falta de conformidad, reparación, sustitución, reducción del precio, reembolso and derecho de desistimiento.

sources.name: Ministerio de Sanidad — Cartera de atención primaria
sources.allowedUse: Use the public service description to validate primary care, referral, prevention, rehabilitation and mental-health terminology; cards are not medical advice.
sources.evidence: The service portfolio uses atención primaria, atención especializada, prescripción, procedimientos diagnósticos y terapéuticos, rehabilitación and salud mental.

sources.name: Carrefour España — Especias y sazonadores
sources.allowedUse: Use the public retailer catalog to verify current shopper-facing Spanish product and category names; do not copy prices, descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: The catalog currently exposes pimienta negra, perejil, comino and laurel as shopper-facing spice names in Spain.

sources.name: Carrefour España — Conservación de alimentos y lavavajillas
sources.allowedUse: Use the public retailer catalog to verify current household-product names; do not copy prices, safety claims, commercial descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: The catalog uses papel de horno and bolsas de congelación; Carrefour's dishwasher category also uses cápsulas and pastillas para lavavajillas.

sources.name: Carrefour España — Higiene y cuidado personal
sources.allowedUse: Use the public retailer catalog to verify current personal-care product and category names; do not copy prices, medical claims, descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: Current personal-care categories and products use enjuague bucal, acondicionador, bastoncillos de algodón, maquinilla de afeitar and crema corporal.

sources.name: Carrefour España — Fideos de trigo
sources.allowedUse: Use the public product label to verify the shopper-facing ingredient name; do not copy the full label, commercial description or image.
sources.evidence: The current product ingredient list uses fideos de trigo cocidos as the product component name.

sources.name: Oriental Market España — Despensa asiática
sources.allowedUse: Use the public Spain-facing retailer catalog to verify product names likely encountered in an Asian-grocery aisle; do not copy prices, commercial descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: The catalog exposes vinagre negro and aceite de cacahuete; related catalog categories expose pasta de soja, pasta de sésamo and aceite de chile.

sources.name: El Corte Inglés Supermercado — Salsa de pescado
sources.allowedUse: Use the public retailer page to verify the Spanish product name; do not copy prices, nutrition tables, descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: The Spain-facing product page names the item salsa de pescado.

sources.name: EcoAsiaShop — Vino de arroz para cocinar
sources.allowedUse: Use the public Spain-facing retailer page to verify the shopper-facing product name; do not copy prices, descriptions or images.
sources.evidence: The retailer uses vino de arroz para cocinar as the current product name; the learning note warns that products and alcohol content differ.
